entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support'.
Connecting you to a support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely worthless shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF88602. And don't 'look into it,' just process the return. These are the worst cycling shoes I've ever owned.
Okay, I have the order pulled up now. Just to understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Are you kidding me? I took them on one ride and they gave me horrible blisters on both heels. And the cleats feel loose no matter how much I tighten them. I want a refund, not a 20-questions interrogation!

I understand your frustration, sir, and I'm very sorry to hear the shoes caused you blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just confirm the return policy for this item.

There's nothing to confirm! Your website says 90 days! Are you trying to get out of this? Get me your manager right now. I swear I will post a review on every single website warning people about this horrible service.

That won't be necessary, sir. You are absolutely correct. I'm just confirming the details on my end. I see your order was delivered 12 days ago, and our standard items, like these shoes, have a 90-day return window. I can approve this return for a full refund for you immediately.
Fine. About time. So you're sending me a label?

Yes, I am. I've just processed the return authorization, and a pre-paid shipping label is on its way to your email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the full refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Whatever. Just make sure it gets done.
It will be. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
